description: A number chosen inside a range by moving a thumb along a track, or a span chosen with two thumbs. A thumb answers the pointer, touch and the keyboard, and a painted fill shows how far along it stands. Across or down, one value or two, it always carries a name and a readout.

label.description: Names what is being set, such as "Volume", and names each thumb. Required, and guarded at runtime: a blank one throws, because nothing can derive what a range measures.

showLabel.description: Draws the label above the track. False drops the drawn text and keeps the accessible name.

hint.description: A line of help under the track, and each thumb's description.

range.description: Draws two thumbs that choose a span: `value` is its start and `valueEnd` its end. Each thumb stops against the other, and each is named by the label and its own word. Without it, `valueEnd` and its two events are ignored, and a bound `valueEnd` is warned once.

value.description: The number the thumb stands at, or the start of the span in range mode. Snapped to `step` and held inside the bounds. Absent, the slider holds its own number, starting at `min`; present, it controls the slider.

valueEnd.description: The end of the span in range mode. Absent, the slider holds its own end, starting at the highest step inside `max`. A `value` above it is drawn at it, and nothing is reported.

max.description: The upper bound. A range whose `max` is not above `min` reads as 0 to 100.

step.description: The increment every value snaps to, counted from `min`; Page Up and Page Down move ten of it. When it does not divide the range, the highest step inside `max` is the top. A step that is not a positive number reads as 1.

orientation.description: Which way the track runs. A vertical slider fills the height its container gives it, at least four control heights, and announces that it stands vertically.

valueFormat.description: How the readout and each thumb's reading write the number. With no `locale` it follows `ArenaLocale.locale`; absent, the number is written as it is.

valuePrefix.description: Static text drawn and spoken before the number, such as `$`.

valueSuffix.description: Static text drawn and spoken after the number, such as `%`.

showValue.description: Whether the readout is drawn beside the label.

disabled.description: Takes each thumb out of the Tab sequence, ignores the pointer and dims the slider.

name.description: Submitted with the form through a hidden input carrying the number. In range mode two hidden inputs share it, the start first, so a form posts a repeated field.

change.description: The thumb moved, or the start thumb in range mode; carries its number on every step of a drag and every key. Never fires for a move that leaves the number where it was.

commit.description: The move settled: the pointer was released, or a key stepped the thumb. Carries the number, and fires only when it differs from where the move began. For an effect too costly to run on every step of a drag.

changeEnd.description: The end thumb moved, in range mode; carries its number as `change` does.

commitEnd.description: The end thumb's move settled, in range mode; carries its number as `commit` does.
